extraction_notes: Revenue deficit and primary deficit are reported as 0 as the state had a revenue surplus of 1.75% of GSDP and a primary surplus of 0.71% of GSDP for the audit year. Outstanding debt is the post-audit figure of total outstanding liabilities (₹72,860.04 crore), which aligns with the reported debt-to-GSDP ratio of 24.08% after excluding back-to-back loans as per notes on page 42. Audit paras raised this year and their money value are based on the sum of outstanding Utilisation Certificates (268 UCs for ₹864.32 crore) and Abstract Contingent bills (74 bills for ₹11.36 crore) identified in the conclusion section on page 168.
